verdict.rationale: TWC's own pages say employers register for unemployment tax through UTR, a free online service. Registration immediately issues a tax account number, can be saved and resumed for up to a year, and allows filing reports and paying taxes due during registration. Ongoing wage reports, tax payments and account management are done online through UTS, with QuickFile for bulk reporting. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the online registration and filing flow works end to end; the application host refused the automated probe, so the transaction itself could not be observed.
